instruction: Look at two_sided_housing.step in NX CAM. Create two independent MCSs or setups for two_sided_housing.step. Side A machines the pocket and four holes; side B machines the two counterbores. The two setup Z axes must point in opposite directions. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill, T2 is a 6 mm end mill, and T3 is a 5 mm drill/counterbore tool as needed. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-20_sideA.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-20_sideB.nc.
